label: Jumpscares
help: Show the full-screen jumpscare image (false = sound only).

label: Jumpscare millis
help: How long the jumpscare image stays on screen.

label: Chase trigger distance
help: Distance at which a staring Tall One starts chasing.

label: Stare trigger seconds
help: Seconds of looking at it while walking closer before it starts chasing.

label: Haunt events
help: It shows up by itself in the distance and stares at you. Every player has their own timer.

label: Haunt first minutes
help: Minutes after joining before the first appearance.

label: Haunt min minutes
help: Minutes between appearances for one player.

label: Haunt only at night
help: Only at night.

label: Max active its
help: Server-wide limit of Its that exist at the same time.

label: Stalking
help: From Stage 2 onward, It slowly approaches while the player is not looking directly at it.

label: Move unseen
help: MOVE_UNSEEN (MODPLAN §3): while you look away, a distant It can reappear closer — never in view.

label: Stalk speed
help: Movement speed used while stalking (separate from the chase speed).

label: Stalk stop distance
help: It stops approaching at or below this distance from the player.

label: Stalk max distance
help: It will not begin stalking when farther away than this distance.

label: Chase speed
help: Speed multiplier while chasing.

label: Jumpscare delay min ticks
help: Ticks between sinking into the ground and the jumpscare.

label: Stare timeout seconds
help: If it is not approached, it gives up staring after this many seconds.

label: Feints
help: FEINT (MODPLAN §3.2, stage 3+): sometimes it screams and runs at you, then simply is not there.

label: Feint chance
help: Chance, once per sighting (after ~1.5 s of you looking at it), that the sighting turns into a feint.

label: Tree peeks
help: TREE (MODPLAN §3.2, stage 2+): instead of standing in the open it peeks out from behind a tree.

label: Tree peek chance
help: Chance that one haunting tries the tree variant first (falls back to the open field if no tree fits).

label: Real knock chance
help: KNOCK (stage 5): chance that a door-knock house event is the real It standing outside the door.

label: Count events
help: THE ONE WHO COUNTS: at night, alone outside, a countdown from ten; a figure closer with every number.

label: Hanged trees
help: THE HANGED: someone hangs from a tree at night (stage 2+), wearing your face, until morning.

label: Tall footprints
help: THE FOOTPRINTS: huge prints walk up to your door and under your windows at night (gone by morning).

label: Mimics
help: THE MIMICS: bloodied cows / sheep / pigs that follow you at night (stage 2+), hit once and vanish.

label: Eye swarms
help: THE EYES: pairs of eyes open in a dark wood at night (stage 2+), close when you bring a light.

label: It voice
help: IT SPEAKS: It's voice lines ("I'm here.", "What are you mining here?") and its lone whispers.

label: Blood moon
help: THE BLOOD MOON: a rare red night (stage 3+) when every event comes twice as often.

label: Blood moon chance
help: Chance each morning (stage 3+) that the coming night is a blood moon.

label: Fog nights
help: FOG NIGHTS: now and then (stage 2+) a night of thick fog, footsteps in it, and It at its edge.

label: Fog night chance
help: Chance of a fog night, decided at dusk (never on a blood moon).

label: Corruption
help: THE CORRUPTION: near the base the world starts to go wrong at night (stage 4+) until dawn or the source breaks.

label: Corruption chance
help: Chance per night and player (inside the base, stage 4+) that a corruption begins.

label: It mimics voices
help: IT MIMICS YOUR VOICE (needs Simple Voice Chat): It keeps short pieces of what players say, in memory only, and plays them back from the dark at night (stage 3+). Off by default: it listens to everyone's voice.

label: Hanged min minutes
help: Minutes between two hanged figures for one player (at most one per night).

label: Count chance
help: Chance per 10 s check while eligible (night, outside, alone; 25-40 min per player between counts).

label: Deep one
help: THE DEEP ONE: crawls on cave ceilings deep underground, douses torches, shakes blocks out of your hands.

label: Deep one max y
help: Only below this height (the player's feet).

label: Deep one chance
help: Chance per 10 s check while eligible (6-10 min per player between two).

label: Guest
help: THE GUEST: an unknown name in YOUR player list, an echo of your chat, a far figure with its back to you.

label: Guest chance
help: Chance per 30 s check (40-70 min per player between two visits).

label: Outspace
help: Sometimes a sleeper is pulled into the dream maze (no damage, no death, the Old One hunts there).

label: Outspace min stage
help: First stage at which it can happen.

label: Outspace chance
help: Chance when someone lies down to sleep (at most one player a night on the whole server).

label: Outspace seconds
help: How long a dream lasts before you wake up in your bed (seconds).

label: Outspace loot chance
help: Chance that a room of the maze holds a chest (dream books, torches, rarely a Warding Crystal).

label: Outspace sleeper chance
help: Share of the great halls of the dream that hold the Sleeper's bed (with a Warding Crystal by it).

label: Corrupted music
help: The game's own songs are sometimes played corrupted (slowed, warbling, dropping out); more in every stage.

section: THE BELOW, the endless caves under the bedrock
label: Below
help: Falling into the void and cracked bedrock lead to the caves under the world.

section: THE BELOW, the endless caves under the bedrock
label: Below min stage
help: First stage at which cracked bedrock appears deep in the mines (the void works always).

section: THE BELOW, the endless caves under the bedrock
label: Cracked bedrock minutes
help: Minutes between two chances of cracked bedrock near a player in the deepest mine (min .. min*2).

label: Photosensitive mode
help: Softer visuals: no flashing frames, gentler vignette and chase pulse, jumpscare image replaced by a dark fade.

label: Effects volume
help: Multiplier for the volume of every sound the mod plays to a player (0 = mute the mod, 1 = normal).

label: Min event cooldown
help: Minimum seconds between two bigger events (house events, window knocks, false presences, Old One, dynamic structures) for the same player. 0 = no global gap, only the per-event cooldowns.

label: Max event range
help: Nothing the mod spawns or places may be farther than this from the player it is meant for (blocks).

label: Custom title screen
help: The title screen shows the night clearing with the Tall One instead of the panorama (client side).

label: Task timer hud
help: The TASK TIMER in the top-left corner while a task runs (client side).

label: Hud extras
help: The extra HUD: heartbeat, time until dusk / dawn, distance to the base, shelter icon, last words on death.

label: Debug allowed for non ops
help: Lets players without operator rights use /itwastall debug ... (read-only views).

label: Window knocks
help: The Tall One knocks three times on a window while you are inside your base at night.

label: Window knock chance
help: Chance rolled per check (~once per 20 s) while the conditions hold; 1 knock burst per night.

label: Old one
help: A "player" named Old One appears close by and stares; walk up to it and It climbs out of it.

label: Old one min stage
help: First stage at which it can appear.

label: Old one first minutes
help: Minutes (per player) before the first one / between two of them.

label: Old one only at night
help: Only after dark (false = any time; it looks more wrong in daylight).

label: Old one split distance
help: How close you get before it tears open.

label: House events
help: Things happen around your mapped base at night: doors, knocks, chests, signs.

label: House event chance per second
help: Chance per second (at night, near your base, stage 2+) that one house event starts.

label: House event cooldown seconds
help: Minimum seconds between two house events for one player.

label: Door events
help: A wooden door of your base opens by itself (stage 3+); it may slam shut again (stage 4+).

label: Chest shuffle
help: A few stacks inside one of your chests swap places (stage 3+). Items are never removed.

label: Sign events
help: A sign with a message appears outside your base (stage 3+).

label: False presence
help: A fake Tall One, rendered only on one client, gone when you look right at it.

label: Lore books
help: Secret lore books may be placed in free slots of the player's mapped storage.

label: Lore book chance
help: Chance per eligible check (every 10 seconds) to place one new book.

label: Lore book cooldown minutes
help: Minimum minutes between books for one player.

label: Scan blocks per tick
help: Minimum blocks the base scanner classifies per tick; it goes faster on its own so a full scan finishes within baseRescanSeconds, but never above scanMaxBlocksPerTick.

label: Scan max blocks per tick
help: Upper limit of blocks per tick for one base scan (all players together: twice this).

label: Base rescan seconds
help: While you are within 64 blocks of your base it is rescanned this often (seconds).

label: Base scan radius
help: Horizontal radius (anchor +-radius) of one base scan.

label: Base interior cap
help: Hard cap of interior cells flood-fill may mark (MODPLAN §8.3 "ograniczenie objętości").

label: Base corner cap
help: Dark interior corners (block light < 4) worth recording for search goals.

label: Task chance per second
help: Chance per second (at night, sheltered, stage 3+) that a task gets assigned.

label: Task cooldown seconds
help: Seconds one player sits on the task cooldown after completing/failing one.

label: Task get inside seconds
help: "Don't go outside", step 1: seconds the player has to GET inside (a house / under a roof).

label: Task stay inside seconds
help: "Don't go outside", step 2: seconds the player then has to STAY inside (MODPLAN 15.1).

label: Task lights count
help: "Douse the lights": how many light markers It picks (up to).

label: Task lights deadline seconds
help: "Douse the lights": seconds until the assignment expires (dawn also kills it).

label: Task hide countdown seconds
help: "Hide and seek" (§15.2, ETAP 5): seconds of the initial hide countdown.

label: Task window look seconds
help: Looking at the figure behind a window gives a "don't go outside" task this long (seconds).

label: Task dont look seconds
help: NIE PATRZ (§15.4, ETAP 4): seconds the watcher stands behind the player.

label: Task sacrifice items
help: OFIARA (§15.5, ETAP 4+): comma-separated possible offering items (vanilla or mod ids).

label: Task sacrifice count
help: OFIARA: how many of the offering item are demanded.

label: Task sacrifice seconds
help: OFIARA: seconds until the unkept offering deal collapses.

label: Base dousing
help: Enables the DouseLightsEvent snuffing mapped base lights at night.

label: Base douse chance
help: Chance per second (night, sheltered, ETAP 4+) that the burst starts.

label: Dynamic structures
help: Enables rare server-built structures (cemetery, shrine, cottage, black copy).

label: Structure chance
help: Chance per second (night, behind the player, one per night) that a build starts.

label: Black copy chance
help: Of those builds, the chance it is the base's black copy (needs a mapped base).

label: Task seek seconds
help: How long It walks the rooms searching before it gives up (survive this long).

label: Task seek check seconds
help: Seconds between two checked dark corners (step/breath cues play at that spot).

label: Task seek find distance
help: Blocks: player sitting this close to the checked corner is FOUND (chase follows).

label: Mine events
help: Enable events while the player is underground (digging towards you, sounds, torches, peeking).

label: Digging
help: It may break blocks while digging towards you (also requires the mobGriefing gamerule).

label: Mine min seconds underground
help: Seconds a player has to spend underground before cave events can start.

label: Mine event cooldown seconds
help: Minimum seconds between two cave events for one player.

label: Mine event chance per second
help: Chance per second (after the minimum time) that a cave event starts.

label: Mine max y
help: Y level below which a dark spot counts as "in a mine".

label: Dig slowdown
help: Digging slowdown: 1.0 = like a player with an iron pickaxe, higher = slower and creepier.

label: Ambient sounds
help: Creepy ambient sounds (wind, whispers, breathing behind you, creaks, drones, distant screams...).

label: Ambient chance per second
help: Chance per second that an ambient sound plays (at night / underground; daytime is 4x rarer).

label: Scare sounds
help: Short scare sounds close to you (twig snap, pebble, tap on glass, footsteps behind, giggle...).

label: Scare messages
help: Red flickering text in the middle of the screen.

label: Scare text
help: The main message (shown about half of the time, and always after it sinks at your base).

label: Message min minutes
help: Random messages at night / underground every this many minutes.

label: Message millis
help: How long a message stays on screen.

label: After ticks
help: Physical elapsed server ticks during PHASE 0 before the IT JOINED sequence may fire (24000 = one day).

label: Require night
help: Require night (time of day 13000..23000) in the Overworld for the automatic activation.

label: Escalation speed
help: Scales every source of tension.

label: Night per sec
help: Tension per second for playing at night in the Overworld.

label: Darkness per sec
help: Tension per second for standing in darkness (block light < 4) at night.

label: Underground per sec
help: Tension per second for being underground (Y below mineMaxY), day or night.
